title: Flaccid
summary: FLAC'CID, adjective [Latin flaccidus, from flacceo, to hand down, to flag.] Soft and weak; limber; lax; drooping; hanging down by its own weight; yielding to pressure for want of firmness and stiffnes

inlines.v: FLAC'CID, adjective [Latin flaccidus, from flacceo, to hand down, to flag.] Soft and weak; limber; lax; drooping; hanging down by its own weight; yielding to pressure for want of firmness and stiffness; as a flaccid muscle; flaccid flesh.
